services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Admission to ExplorationWorks for up to 15 children (and up to 10 adults) for the duration of your party The party room is located on the main floor and will be rented out for 2 hours. The party room includes tables, chairs, tablecloths, and trash bins. You are encouraged to bring your own food, beverages, and decorations. Note that the party room does not include access to a refrigerator or freezer; please plan ahead before bringing frozen foods. All food, beverages, and decor must remain in the party room.
